clusters.title: Price Range
clusters.description: Vietnamese food prices vary widely, with meals ranging from inexpensive street food to pricier restaurant options. A typical meal can cost between 20,000 to 300,000 VND, depending on the type and location. Common items like rice dishes and banh mi are affordable, while full meals at restaurants can be more expensive.

Additionally, a McMeal at McDonald's is priced at 118,500 VND, and basic groceries like rice and milk are relatively affordable.
